messages:
maria: Quick question — while wiring up the new 'routing policy suggester' in the experiment stepper, how should we enforce canary constraints? The UX currently lets users pick arbitrary seed weights and traffic ramps. We should probably prevent >25% initial canary unless there's an explicit enterprise override.

ashwin: +1. Conservative defaults make sense. Also we need the stepper to call the routing service to surface 'quota headroom' so users get a live warning if capacity is tight.

jamie: Telemetry angle: we should allow attaching an eval set at creation time so smoke regressions are caught during the canary. Suggest a small checkbox: "run smoke evals on canary" that kicks off background eval jobs.

olivia: On quotas: propose default per-variant QPS cap = 10 and a per-experiment daily token budget that prevents runaway spend. If they try to schedule a ramp that exceeds headroom, show a blocking guard.

maria: What about seed weighting behaviour? The current seed algorithm ends up biased when weights are tiny — tiny variants may not get enough unique users for stable metrics. Maybe enforce a min seed per variant (e.g., 1k users) or clamp seed_frac when absolute users < threshold.

ashwin: API suggestion: add explicit fields so stepper doesn't guess. Something like: 

```json
{
  "variants": [{"id":"A","seed":0.01},{"id":"B","seed":0.99}],
  "seed_min_users": 1000,
  "initial_cap_pct": 5,
  "ramp_steps": [5,20,50]
}
```

jamie: Also emit a telemetry event `experiment.preflight` with sample_size, expected_margin_of_error, and required_sample_size so console can show confidence bands next to metric expectations. That will help PMs decide if the canary is worth it.

deploy-bot: Canary pool created in us-west-2 for experiment 'exp-3887'; current capacity headroom = 1800 rps :rocket:

olivia: UX note: prefer non-blocking warnings for small infra issues, but for safety / cost we should block when initial_cap_pct > 25% unless an `enterprise_override` flag is present (which must create an audit log entry).

maria: OK — plan: update stepper to enforce initial_cap_pct <= 25 by default, expose an override toggle that requires audit text, add `seed_min_users` property and clamp logic, and wire the quota_headroom call into the confirm screen. I'll open a PR tomorrow morning.

ashwin: Please add unit tests for seed clamping and an e2e that validates the warning / blocking behavior for big initial caps. :thumbsup:

jamie: I'll add the `experiment.preflight` event in evals-service and coordinate with telemetry dashboards to show the confidence bands.

maria: thanks — tagging @olivia for UX follow-up on copy and @ashwin for API contract review.
